text:
tom.ae: FYI procurement put the Nimbus POC on hold. They need a signed data-residency attestation + a firm pilot spend cap before releasing the PO. Can Eng/Sec join a 20m sync today?

leah.presales: I can take it. Do we have a one-page attestation template Legal accepts, or should Sec draft quickly? Also, is the cap total for 30 days or weekly?

matt.sec: We have a standard one-pager. Key items: region lock, no raw-data egress without approval, 90-day audit log retention. Need to confirm KMS (BYOK vs Redwood) and whether they need an HSM attestation.

sophia.eng: Dedicated VPC pilot can be provisioned in ~72h. On-prem would add weeks. If they require model pinning/quantization, we'll want a short compatibility run against their samples.

ana.csm: Procurement insisted on a hard cap. Finance must approve. If we get attestation signed, I'll get the exec sponsor intro.

leah.presales: Proposed: 30-day Dedicated pilot, optional BYOK, pilot cap $3,750 total or $0.0007/token overage (customer-favoring). Present as proposal; need Finance confirmation.

matt.sec: Draft attestation (legal review required):

"Data Residency Attestation (draft) - All customer data processed only in region: eu-west-1. - No export of raw data outside the region without customer approval. - Customer may elect BYOK or Redwood-managed keys with HSM. - Inference request audit logs retained for 90 days."

proc-bot: Ticket SD-8822 created (Nimbus POC hold). Assigned: leah.presales, matt.sec, legal-team.

sophia.eng: Reserving staging slot. If BYOK, start KMS onboarding paperwork (24-48h). Recommend a 1-hour compatibility test once sanitized samples are uploaded.

ana.csm: Uploading sanitized samples now and inviting Eng/Sec.

leah.presales: Plan: 1) Send draft attestation + pricing to customer today, 2) schedule 20-30m CTO/CISO call tomorrow with our execs, 3) run compatibility test once samples are in. Target: PO by Fri EOD if Legal/Finance sign.

proc-bot: SD-8822 status -> "awaiting legal review"

matt.sec: Legal requested addendum: "Redwood will provide SOC2 report and completed security questionnaire within 48 hours of request." Getting legal eyes now.

leah.presales: Thanks team 12: I'll post the signed attestation here when ready.
